request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work (law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, company and plant
documents) using ONLY the documents in the current folder, one text file per document; README.md lists them with their rank. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need: search in English and in Italian, follow references from one article or annex to another, and read the whole section before you rely on it.

Rules:
- Use only the files. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- Answer only if a passage states the answer for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the same article
  and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline). A passage about a neighbouring subject does not
  answer the question: then the kind is "unknown" and the value is null. A question about something that happened
  (the date of the last check, whether something is overdue today) is "unknown" unless a passage records that event.
- A passage marked "corrected by the corrigendum" already shows the corrected wording: reason with it. The old
  wording, given in the mark, is no longer valid.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the passages, one by one. A repeal or an
  application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a date is still fully in
  force on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does not yet bind on earlier days.
- When passages of different rank disagree, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's manual,
  then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.) wins over a
  ministerial decree (DM). Say which one wins.
- A row of a table belongs to the thing named in that same row. Read the row of the item asked about, not a
  neighbouring row. When the question itself states a condition ("if it were in regular use", "built in 2017"),
  reason with that condition.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / by which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "how often / for how
  long / within what time" is "duration"; "can / may / is / does / must" is "boolean"; "which / what (several
  things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition is "text" (one short sentence naming every element asked for).
- Point at the evidence: for every passage you rely on, copy word for word the sentence, or the table row, that
  states what you use. Copy exactly, without changing a character; do not join text from two places.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not state it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "what the passages say and how it leads to the answer, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y", "P6M", "P45D", "PT1H" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "evidence": [{"file": "<file name>", "quote": "<copied exactly from that file, one sentence or one table row>"}]}
request.prompt:
Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: According to the robot cell sheet, must the reset of the emergency stop devices take place outside the Protected Space?

What the fact store already holds on this question (facts taken earlier from these same documents, each with the
sentence it comes from). They are leads, not the answer: a fact can be incomplete, about a neighbouring subject,
or wrong. Check each one you use against the files, and search further whenever they do not settle the question.
The store has no answer of its own.
Facts (subject | relation | value | condition | [document, place]):
- isola robotizzata | safeguarded space rule | devono sempre avere inizio prima di entrare nello spazio protetto | [robot-cell-sheet, p. 6] | sentence: "Principali macchine • Le operazioni di programmazione devono sempre avere inizio prima di entrare nello spazio protetto."
- Arresto di emergenza | has safety function | Categoria 3 della Norma ISO 13849-1:1999 (categoria 3) | if: o comunque come previsto dalla valutazione del rischio | [robot-cell-sheet, p. 4] | sentence: "Arresto di Emergenza Arresto di Sicurezza Posizionamento Il comando deve essere collocato in modo Il comando deve essere collocato tenendo conto che l’operatore vi abbia un accesso libero e rapido del calcolo delle distanze di sicurezza Azionamento Manuale Automatico o manuale Prestazione di sicurezza In conformità alla Categoria 3 della Norma In conformità alla Categoria 3 della Norma ISO 13849-1"
- macchina | has safety function | almeno un comando di arresto di emergenza (at least 1) | [robot-cell-sheet, p. 4] | sentence: "Principali macchine Arresto di sicurezza La macchina deve disporre di un dispositivo di comando (vedi 2.2.6.3 “Arresto”) che consenta l’arresto in condizioni di sicurezza Arresto di emergenza Ogni macchina deve essere dotata di almeno un comando di arresto di emergenza (vedi 2.2.6.4 “Arresto d’emergenza”)"
- isola robotizzata | safeguarded space rule | l’accesso a tale area deve poter avvenire solo quando | [robot-cell-sheet, p. 1] | sentence: "l’accesso a tale area deve poter avvenire solo quando tutte le macchine com- prese nell’isola sono in condizioni di sicurezza ."
- isola robotizzata | safeguarded space rule | tutta l’area attorno alla isola robotizzata deve essere delimitata | [robot-cell-sheet, p. 1] | sentence: "Per la particolarità dei robot, di compiere movimenti molto ampi, ad alta energia e velocità con avvio ed andamen- to del moto difficili da prevedere, tutta l’area attorno alla isola robotizzata deve essere delimitata in modo tale che dall’esterno non sia possibile venire a contatto con i suoi elementi pericolosi"
- Spazio Protetto | defined as | Spazio Protetto | [robot-cell-sheet, p. 1] | sentence: "Tale area è definita “Spazio Protetto”;"
- sostituzione di parti, dispositivi o componenti di sicurezza | must keep register | registrate secondo gli schemi del Modello C (Modello C) | if: Qualora l’intervento di manutenzione richieda la sostituzione di parti, dispositivi o componenti di sicurezza | [unict-guideline, p. 9] | sentence: "Qualora l’intervento di manutenzione richieda la sostituzione di parti, dispositivi o componenti di sicurezza, le singole sostituzioni devono essere registrate secondo gli schemi del Modello C."
- autonomous mobile machinery | requires measure | an enclosed zone fitted with a peripheral protection system comprising guards or… | if: with one or both where necessary according to the risk assessment | [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3] | sentence: "Autonomous mobile machinery or related products shall comply, with one or both where necessary according to the risk assessment, of the following conditions: (i) it shall move and operate in an enclosed zone fitted with a peripheral protection system comprising guards or protective devices;"
- control devices | requires measure | protected against any accidental release | [DIR, Annex I, 5.3] | sentence: "The control devices must be protected against any accidental release."
- control devices | requires measure | protected against any accidental release | [REG, Annex III, 5.3] | sentence: "The control devices shall be protected against any accidental release."
- cleaning where entering cannot be avoided | requires measure | designed and constructed in such a way as to allow cleaning to… (designed to allow cleaning to take place safely) | if: If it is impossible to avoid entering the machinery or related product | [REG, Annex III, 1.6.5] | sentence: "If it is impossible to avoid entering the machinery or related product, it shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to allow cleaning to take place safely."
- 1.2.4.4 assembly of machinery | requires measure | stop controls, including the emergency stop devices | if: if its continued operation may be dangerous | [DIR, Annex I, 1.2.4.4] | sentence: "Assembly of machinery In the case of machinery or parts of machinery designed to work together, the machinery must be designed and constructed in such a way that the stop controls, including the emergency stop devices, can stop not only the machinery itself but also all related equipment, if its continued operation may be dangerous."
- controllo efficienza dei dispositivi di sicurezza | requires periodic check | GIORNALIERA (P1D) | [unict-guideline, p. 7] | sentence: "Trapano a colonna) INTERVENTO FREQUENZA INCARICATO MODALITA’ CONTROLLO EFFICIENZA DEI DISPOSITIVI DI SICUREZZA GIORNALIERA OPERATORE PROCEDURA P1 CONTROLLO DEL CORREDO DELLA MACCHINA UTENSILE GIORNALIERA OPERATORE Ispezione visiva PULIZIA DELLA TAVOLA DELLA MORSA GIORNALIERA OPERATORE PROCEDURA P2 VERIFICA INTEGRITA’"
- control devices (1.2.2) | requires measure | emergency stop devices | if: liable to be subjected to considerable forces | [DIR, Annex I, 1.2.2] | sentence: "particular attention must be paid to emergency stop devices liable to be subjected to considerable forces."
- control devices for carrier movements | requires measure | override any other devices | if: with the exception of emergency stop devices | [REG, Annex III, 6.2] | sentence: "In operation, those control devices shall override any other devices controlling the same movement with the exception of emergency stop devices."
